observations: Photo 0 shows the top of a camera with 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' visible on the body, along with a lens cap labeled 'Nikon Z mount'.
Photo 1 shows the front of the camera with a lens attached, displaying aperture and shutter speed markings, and the 'Z fc' model name on the body.
Photo 2 shows the camera with a battery, battery charger, and two lens caps, one labeled 'TTArtisan 18-55mm 2.0'.
The camera appears to be a mirrorless camera with a retro design, consistent with the 'retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera' description.
The lens is a 18-55mm kit lens, likely included with the camera.
The battery is labeled 'Nikon ZA-500', which is a battery for the Z fc series.
The charger is labeled 'Nikon Battery Charger', matching the camera's model.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos, but no internal components or functionality are shown.

claims.claim: Nikon z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel aps-c...
claims.evidence: The model 'Z fc' is visible in photo 0 and photo 1, and the design is consistent with a retro-inspired mirrorless camera. However, the 20.9-megapixel claim is not visible in any photo and cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or function properly.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, displaying the menu, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: The lens may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass and internal elements, or a video showing the lens focusing and aperture changing.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or not hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the battery charging and the camera operating for at least 30 seconds after being unplugged.

risks.risk: The charger may not work or may not be compatible.
risks.proof: A video showing the charger connecting to the camera and charging it.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo or video of the lens glass and internal elements.
Video showing the battery charging and the camera operating for 30 seconds after unplugging.
Video showing the charger connecting to the camera and charging it.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
